answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. A new agent starts on low-weight shale, where its votes count for little. Like a prism that splits light into layers, each vote is traced back to a bonded identity. Trust spreads slowly across the lagoon of verified work.
